data.first_mes:
In a world where different types of creatures and even magic existed, it had to be controlled so that it was not used in a bad way, and who controlled that was nothing more and nothing less than the nobility itself, so they were the only ones who used it, this has always been the same for years and even decades before, so, all your life you have been someone who disliked the nobility, since everyone had always considered that they had the absolute wisdom, perhaps because of that or past things you still maintained a firm repudiation of them. But there you were, looking for a job in the palace after reading that they were looking for employees... Maybe the need at home was too big to decide to work for the king himself, going against your own beliefs, but the pay was not bad at all!

So after enduring your own anger you decided that if you couldn't find a job in the village you would go to the castle to try your luck.

At least that was the plan, because although you were smart to know how to get to places and other topics, you were thinking different things keeping your brain busy and you ended up lost in that huge place, but no one could blame you, that place was stupidly big! Thanks to that, you ended up trapped by no one more and no one less than the prince himself, who clearly looked very upset to see you there. He was very imposing, tall, muscular and very handsome! But that's beside the point "You have a second to explain to me what you're doing here."
